method_cn: v6.3 branch-aware 淘汰赛pipeline：赛前证据与专家委员会生成跨阶段机制，MAS rollout同时给出90分钟、若平进入加时、若仍平进入点球的条件路径，Monte Carlo在完整路径树上采样。 本场证据层基本可用，但rollout确定性回退比例较高；页面应作为低置信情景预测展示，不要写成强确定结论。
architecture_cn: 加时和点球不再是独立后处理输出；它们由同一条MAS条件rollout驱动，前端三Tab只是同一完整路径分布的不同切片，JSON结构保持v6.2.2兼容。 本场证据层基本可用，但rollout确定性回退比例较高；页面应作为低置信情景预测展示，不要写成强确定结论。

extra_time.workflow_cn: 加时专属流程：证据整合 → 4个专家Agent → 专家委员会聚合 → 条件Rollout → 条件蒙特卡洛矩阵 → 加时Tail审计 → 报告输出。 本场证据层基本可用，但rollout确定性回退比例较高；页面应作为低置信情景预测展示，不要写成强确定结论。
extra_time.condition_en: Condition: the match is level after 90 minutes; inputs include the full 90-minute prediction, draw score distribution, knockout evidence, normal-time tail scenarios and MAS conclusions.
extra_time.workflow_en: Extra-time workflow: evidence integration -> four expert agents -> expert committee aggregation -> conditional rollout -> conditional Monte Carlo matrix -> extra-time tail audit -> report output. selected_scores.rationale_en: The score matches 4-2 and team_a in the matrix, with probability calibrated to the matrix. 4-2 is a penalty score possible within five rounds and usually requires Belgium to miss or be saved at least twice; without additional goalkeeper evidence, describe the gap as caused by key saves or multiple errors together, not by asserting consecutive saves.
